name: questions.business_context.baseline
description: Baseline intake questions covering business drivers, stakeholders, and constraints.

questions.text: What is the primary business goal driving this engagement?
questions.rationale: Anchors every downstream recommendation — without a clear goal, tradeoffs can't be evaluated.

questions.text: Who are the target users or customer segments, and what problems are we solving for them?
questions.rationale: User context shapes NFRs (scale, latency, geography) and guides feature prioritisation.

questions.text: What are the non-negotiable business constraints (deadlines, budget caps, regulatory mandates)?
questions.rationale: Hard constraints bound the solution space before any technical trade-off is considered.

questions.text: Who are the key stakeholders and decision-makers on the sponsor side?
questions.rationale: Review loops and buy-in depend on getting the right names into the stakeholder map.

questions.text: What does 'success' look like 12–18 months after delivery? Any measurable KPIs?
questions.rationale: Measurable outcomes sharpen roadmap sequencing and unlock evidence-based scoring.
